area: Antarctica (Antarctic Treaty area, south of 60 degrees S)
governingFramework: Antarctic Treaty; Protocol on Environmental Protection (Madrid Protocol), including Annex III on waste; IAATO operator guidelines
finding: No IAATO or Antarctic Treaty document addressing cremated remains or ashes was found. IAATO's general principle is leave-no-trace; a CNN first-person essay reports an expedition guide saying scattering would breach the Antarctic Treaty. Whether scattering at sea in the Treaty area (as opposed to on land) is addressed by the Protocol or national permitting authorities is unverified.

governingFramework: Forskrift om kirkegårder i Longyearbyen og askespredning på Svalbard (FOR-2008-02-15-153)
finding: Ash scattering on Svalbard requires a permit from the Governor (Sysselmesteren) on application. Per search summary of the regulation: not in built-up areas or where it causes nuisance; conditions may be attached; permit possible where the deceased (over 15) applied or is shown to have wanted scattering; appeals go to the Ministry.

governingFramework: US EPA MPRSA general permit (ocean, beyond 3 nm); state and federal land/park rules; operator policies
finding: Federal rule for ocean scattering: at least three nautical miles from land, reported to EPA within 30 days (search summaries). Alaska has no general state statute on where ashes may be scattered (Nolo, secondary). Cunard's own policy bars lowering ashes in Alaska state waters. Glacier Bay National Park rules not found.

sources.title: US EPA: Burial at Sea
sources.quote: at least three nautical miles from land
sources.accessNote: Not reachable; quote from search snippet. US MPRSA general permit, US waters only.

sources.title: Cunard: Committal of ashes at sea
sources.quote: Ashes cannot be lowered from Cunard ships in protected bodies of water such as the Norwegian fjords or Alaska state waters.
sources.accessNote: Cunard's own policy only; not reachable directly, quote from search snippet. Shows how one line treats Alaska state waters; does not bind other operators.
